items.title: I flat out failed to realize just how good of a year Tre Jones had last season.
items.author: Morten Stig Jensen
items.body_excerpt:
I flat out failed to realize just how good of a year Tre Jones had last season.

I'm generally skeptical of the Bulls, but if they play this right, all three of Jones, Powell & Claxton could fetch something nice at the trade deadline.
